item.title: Delays ahead for truckies on Gwydir Highway for slope work
item.description: The Gwydir Highway on the Gibraltar Range has a long history of remedial work. Image: TfNSW Truckies are advised of changed traffic conditions from next week on the Gwydir Highway on the Gibraltar Range, NSW, to stabilise three slopes and reduce the impacts of future weather events. Starting Monday, February 23, Transport for NSW (TfNSW) said work will be carried out from 7am to 6pm and is expected to be completed by Saturday, March 21, weather permitting. item.title: Geelong certification opens door to cleaner diesel for trucking industry
item.description: The certification clears the way for renewable diesel to be produced at Viva Energy's Geelong refinery. Image: Viva Energy Viva Energy’s Geelong refinery has received international certification for the production of co-processed renewable diesel. Co-processed renewable diesel is a 'drop-in' product that is manufactured by processing a biogenic oil such as used cooking oil alongside traditional crude oil. item.title: $49.5 million to upgrade 34 kilometres of the Tanami
item.description: The new Tanami contract is part of a broader program of works across the Territory. Image: Adwo/stock.adobe.com The Australian and Northern Territory governments have awarded a $49.5 million contract to upgrade a further 34 kilometres of Tanami Road. NT business Exact Contracting has been enlisted to upgrade the road between Renehans Bore and Refrigerator Bore – an important freight, mining, pastoral and tourism route. item.title: Regional truck wash reopens after major upgrades
item.description: The problems plaguing the Euroa facility have now been resolved. Image: Strathbogie Shire Council The Euroa Truck Wash in north-east Victoria is open again after months of major upgrades. Strathbogie Shire Council announced the news on its Facebook page yesterday after the Boundary Road facility had to be shut down for nearly a year due to a pump design flaw.
